name: checkHit
description: Determines whether an attack misses, hits normally, or critically hits. Uses a weighted random roll across three outcomes: Miss, Normal, and Crit.

parameters.ignoreMiss: boolean, default false — if true, miss rate is forced to 0

config_used.miss_correct: Power curve exponent for miss correction (from ConfigGlobal)
config_used.chapterType: Determines if current battle is PvE (no PvP cap applied)

formula_steps.formula: crit_rate = attacker.crit_rate, ignore_crit = defender.ignore_crit_rate, effective_crit = max(crit_rate - ignore_crit, 0)

formula_steps.description: Apply power curve correction to miss chance
formula_steps.note: miss_correct is a global config value; dividing by 10000 converts from basis points. The power curve compresses high miss rates.

formula_steps.description: Apply PvP miss cap (only in PvP battles)
formula_steps.formula: pvp_cap = round(battle_up_limit[0][1] / 10000); if (not PvE): final_miss = min(corrected_miss, pvp_cap); else: final_miss = corrected_miss

ranges[Miss] = roundInt(10000 * final_miss), ranges[Normal] = ranges[Miss] + roundInt(round(1 - final_miss) * round(1 - effective_crit) * 10000), ranges[Crit] = ranges[Normal] + roundInt(round(1 - final_miss) * effective_crit * 10000)

formula_steps.description: Roll random number and determine outcome
formula_steps.formula: rand = randomInt(0, 10000); if rand <= ranges[Miss]: return Miss(0); else if rand <= ranges[Normal]: return Normal(1); else: return Crit(2)

notes: The three outcomes (Miss/Normal/Crit) partition the 0-10000 range
Due to rounding, the sum of ranges may not exactly equal 10000; any remainder falls into Crit
In PvE battles (determined by chapterType config), the PvP miss cap is not applied
The power curve correction (step 4) means raw_miss is scaled non-linearly — e.g., with miss_correct=5000 (exponent 0.5), a 25% raw miss becomes ~50% after correction (sqrt)
